title: A cationic lanthanide-based fluorescent sensor for highly selective and on-site detection of chromium oxyanions

material_class.structural_family: cationic cubane [Tb4(OH)4(H2O)6]8+ cluster with bppCOO ligands

synthesis.procedure: A mixture of Tb(NO3)3·5H2O (0.01 mmol, 0.0045 g), bppCOOH (0.01 mmol, 0.0026 g), 0.1 mL DMF and 0.4 mL deionized water was loaded into a 5 mL glass vial, sealed, and heated at 100 °C for 5 days, then cooled to room temperature. The product was washed with deionized water and ethanol.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 5 mL sealed glass vial, solvothermal heating
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: cooled to room temperature; washed with deionized water and ethanol

properties.summary: Green Tb3+ photoluminescence under 365 nm excitation with characteristic 5D4→7FJ bands; PL lifetime 958.63 μs and PLQY 18.58%. Selective static luminescence quenching by CrO42− and Cr2O72− (Ksv 7.2(1)×10^3 and 1.5(1)×10^4 M−1; LODs 148 nM and 58 nM) via inner-filter/competitive absorption around 365 nm after oxyanion adsorption. Hydrolytic/photoluminescence stability over pH 4–10; Tb-bppCOO@PVDF films used for on-site RGB sensing of Cr2O72−.

measurements.name: emission maxima
measurements.conditions: λex = 365 nm; 5D4→7FJ (J = 6–3); additional bands 635–686 nm for J = 0–2

measurements.name: photoluminescence lifetime
measurements.conditions: ambient conditions; bulk sample on Edinburgh FLS 980

measurements.name: photoluminescence quantum yield
measurements.conditions: ambient conditions; HORIBA Fluorolog-3 with QY accessory

measurements.name: limit of detection
measurements.conditions: CrO42− (~17 ppb); linear regression of [(I0−I)/I0]% vs [Q]
